sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
When someone chooses to follow Jesus, his or her desire is to obey Him. Today, we will learn another command that Jesus has given us. That command is to take baptism.
Romans 6:3-6
Acts 16:25-34 (Philippian Jailer)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
Just like the Philippian Jailer, when someone chooses to follow Jesus, they should immediately take baptism.
Baptism does not save us from our sin.
Followers of Jesus take baptism out of obedience to Jesus.
Baptism is a public profession of faith in Jesus Christ.
Baptism is symbolic of the death, burial, and resurrection of Christ.
Baptism shows others that we have died to sin and have been raised with Christ to walk in a new life.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Is anyone ready to be obedient to Jesus and take baptism?
If yes, then make a plan for them to take baptism.
If not, ask again after each lesson. Do not continue beyond lesson 25 with unbaptized believers.
If needed, there is extra teaching on baptism available in the back of this book within the “Church Essentials” section.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God’s Word tells us that if we love Him, we will obey His commands. Let our love for God lead us to obey His word!
John 14:15
Pray
Ask God to help us learn His Word and then do what it says. May we be people who always obey Jesus.
